senses.gloss:
ऊर्ध्व ऊर्ध्व, i. e. ऋध् + व, adj., f. वा.
 1. Erect, Hiḍ. 3, 2.
 2. Raised (as dust), Man. 11, 110.
 3. Upper, MBh. 1, 1034.
 4. The name of a kind of flying, Pañc. ii. d. 57.
 वम्, adv.
 1. Upwards, Rām. 4, 8, 5.
 2. Above, Man. 1, 92.
 3. After, Rām. 3, 53, 4; after death, Man. 9, 104.
 --Cf. ὀρθός; Lat. arduus.

ऊर्ध्वग ऊर्ध्व-ग (vb. गम्), adj., f. गा.
 1. Going upwards, MBh. 3, 850.
 2. Being in the air.
ऊर्ध्वपुण्ड्रक ऊर्ध्व-पुण्ड्र + क, m. A perpendicular line on the forehead [] made with sandal, etc.; a sectarial mark, Lass. 70, 11.

ऊर्ध्व- + गति ऊर्ध्व- + गति,
 I. f. going onwards, Suśr. 1, 151, 12.
 II. adj. rising, Rām. 1, 2, 40.
ऊर्ध्व- + देह ऊर्ध्व- + देह, n. obsequies, Rām. 2, 90, 37 Gorr.
ऊर्ध्व- + मन्थिन् ऊर्ध्व- + मन्थिन्, adj. chaste (cf. मथिन्), Bhāg. P. 5, 3, 20.
ऊर्ध्व- + मुख ऊर्ध्व- + मुख, adj. of which the aperture is turned upward; turned upward, Kumāras. 1, 16.

ऊर्ध्व- + रेतस् ऊर्ध्व- + रेतस्,
 I. adj. chaste, MBh. 2, 470; Hariv. 949.
 II. m. a name of Śiva, MBh. 13, 1160.

ऊर्ध्व- + रोमन् ऊर्ध्व- + रोमन्,
 I. adj. one whose hairs are erect, Bhāg. P. 6, 1, 28.
 II. m. the name of a mountain, ib. 5, 20, 15.
ऊर्ध्व- + वृत ऊर्ध्व- + वृत, adj. worn over the shoulder, Man. 2, 44.
ऊर्ध्व- + शायिन् ऊर्ध्व- + शायिन्, m. a name of Śiva, MBh. 13, 1160.
